correctness.rationale: For odd q, the norm-coordinate image is the stated quadratic-residue epigraph. Its indicator decomposes as half of a constant, quadratic character, and zero-delta. Each nontrivial first-coordinate Fourier coefficient equals a quadratic Gauss sum times 1+G(xi); its squared magnitude is q|1+G(xi)|^2/4. Sum fourth powers by additive Parseval, using G(1)^2=chi(-1)q and |G(1)|^2=q. The closed integer formula follows for every odd prime power. The packaged direct enumerator matches nine fields.

value.rationale: The additive energy of a polynomial image is a motivated four-point collision invariant relevant to additive expansion; unlike its value-set size or the known fiber counts, it detects interactions among distinct outputs. The exact formula for every odd q and the q mod 4 arithmetic dichotomy are nontrivial consequences of an explicit two-level Fourier magnitude structure.
